function.description: Returns the triggered jobs by the activity with the given activity id
function.name: api_getTriggeredJobsByActivityId

limit.description: Maximum number of records to be fetched. If not provided, 500 records will be fetched by default

offset.description: The first record to show for this page. Minimum value is 1

order.description: Whether ascending or descending order should be used to sort the response.

sortBy.description: A property within the response to sort by.

description.description: The description of the triggered job

id.description: The id of the triggered job

status.description:
Triggered job state:
 * 'NOT_STARTED' - job hasn't started
 * 'IN_PROGRESS' - job is running
 * 'SUCCESS' - job has completed with success
 * 'FAILURE' - job has completed with failure

taskId.description: The id of the task for the job that was triggered

taskUrl.description: The path to the API endpoint to GET information on the task
